# Faern Resorts

> Faern Resorts operates a collection of luxury alpine hotels across Switzerland's premier mountain destinations including Arosa, Sils-Maria, Wengen, and Crans-Montana.

The resort collection features four distinctive properties: Hotel Altein in Arosa, Schweizerhof Sils Maria in Upper Engadin, Victoria Lauberhorn in Wengen near Jungfrau, and Hotel Valaisia in Crans-Montana. Each resort offers alpine wellness, year-round activities, and seasonal ski packages with the Arosa Card and regional ski passes.
